verdict.rationale: 1Password's own support docs say you can export your information from the 1Password apps to move it to a different app, so the leave-and-migrate core is a first-party capability. The pack never says which formats that export produces or whether it covers all data. CSV and Credential Exchange are only documented for import, and CLI/SDK item access is a building block rather than an export feature, so neither is credited. Missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), confirmation that the export covers all item types and attachments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can export your information from the 1Password apps if you want to move it to a different app.
